conversation_parts.body: Morning Bryn, it’s Gellin from Saltmarsh. We’re seeing some issues with how claims get assigned and docs get filed — can we talk it through?
I’m here to help with your Keelwater claims system query. Could you clarify which feature you’re having trouble with?
Thanks for reaching out, Gellin. I’ll connect you with Bryn right away. Please hold for 30 seconds.
Hi Gellin, Bryn here. I’ve pulled up your account. What’s the main pain point you’re facing?
Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team-level thing.

Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team-level thing. We need manual claim routing options configurable per team.

Bryn, please note that Saltmarsh Specialty’s team needs per-team routing controls — motor teams want automation, but complex commercial claims require manual handling. This is a high-priority config request.
Got it. You’re asking for different routing behaviours per team — that’s a valid config need. I’ll log this as a feature request for our product team.
Internal note: Gellin Glenmere’s account (A07) flagged misfiled evidence and routing conflicts. Escalate to product config team for team-level toggle design.
Also, garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it.

Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real delays and oversight risks.
That’s a critical workflow issue. I’ll flag this as a classification bug — we’ll investigate why the system misfiles those documents and how to fix the auto-tagging.
Thanks Bryn. We really need this sorted — handlers are wasting time fixing incorrect file type assignments, and it’s impacting claim accuracy.
Handlers are spending too much time fixing the incorrect file type assignments — we need a better way to classify garage estimates so we don’t miss critical evidence during claims processing.
Understood. I’ll escalate this to our engineering team today. You’ll get an update by end of week. Anything else I can help with?
No, that’s all for now. Appreciate the quick response.
